findings.text: 面向需要经常从SkillHub发现、固定版本安装和维护技能的DSH用户。原办法是浏览网页、下载归档、复制技能目录和手工记录版本；合格结果应区分文件完成、库存记录、DSH发现与模型实际调用。组件仅是plugins/dsh原生桥接，不将SkillHub服务或CLI整体能力算成插件实现。

Host通过RegistryAdapter读取目录和详情，ConversationSelections用sessionId、cwd、sourceRevision绑定候选；引用过期拒绝，不改装当前latest。install工具解析唯一selectionRef或坐标，需可信活动会话；LocalRuntime先accept并尽早返回操作回执，随后执行完整安装。旧进程未完成journal呈unknown而不自动重放；当前库存与历史操作结果分开，DSH发现不确定不会推翻已完成文件结果。
仅检查固定版本的作者说明、注册入口和下列实际源码；未执行目标代码、安装或真实宿主验收。
只按该组件实际类型与固定路径研究，不将目录收录等同宿主可加载。

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次使用 | 网络与宿主资源未知 | 依赖、来源、库存备份 | 严格组合门禁 |
| 持续使用 | 版本查询资源 | 技能复核和位置管理 | 不证明安全或效果 |
| 失败恢复 | 未决写入可能已发生 | 按原回执核验恢复 | 禁用包不卸载技能 |
可供技能维护频繁且能核对宿主依赖的用户在独立账户或容器里试用公开测试技能的固定版本安装。相比手工复制，它多了来源、位置和原事务回执，但不证明技能已运行或安全。出现unknown事务、库存冲突或依赖组合不符时停止新写入，查询并恢复原操作，保留技能文件与日志后退回人工核对。 依据[Q09](#research-q09)。

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 管理一致性 | scope、指纹与操作回执 | 所有文件事务故障覆盖 |
| 技能可用 | 发现confirmed/unconfirmed区分 | 模型实际使用与安全 |
值得借鉴的是Host-only selection scope、accepted与完成分离、旧journal转unknown、受理后独立生命周期，以及操作前重新检查路径/策略。移植需连同本地安装核心、指纹与日志契约，不能仅复用UI。归档指纹和来源核验不判断技能指令是否可信；审核和模型真实运行要作为独立验收。
相对网页下载加手工复制，增量是精确版本与指纹、用户/项目位置、来源和会话范围绑定，以及结果未知时查原操作。它把“安装成功”的多个阶段拆开，避免同名目录认领其他来源或把accepted当完成。业务仍是技能分发维护，不是自动证明技能安全或更好完成用户任务；匿名市场审核不可访问不能当通过。 依据[Q03](#research-q03)。

关键质疑是安装文件到模型真正可用之间存在多层状态。Host已经把discovery confirmed/unconfirmed分开，README明确本地文件存在不代表DSH启用、历史完成不代表当前安装。兼容门禁严格到Host/Client发行版和Cordis组合，普通profile隔离也不隔离共享inventory。旧CLI与v2库存混写、或只恢复旧inventory而不恢复技能文件，会破坏管理假设。 依据[Q04](#research-q04)。
未验证假设是将“文件已完成、当前发现、允许调用、最近真实使用”并列显示，能减少用户因技能不可用而重复安装。用同名覆盖、禁用用户调用、旧回执、来源变更和Host重启场景，比较当前提示与四状态卡的重复提交数和问题定位时间。若用户仍把历史成功误解为当前可用，或检查扰动文件状态，应停止扩大自动管理。 依据[Q08](#research-q08)。

      "content": "# SkillHub for DeepSeek Harness

[English](README.en.md)

SkillHub 的 DSH 原生插件。在 DSH 侧栏打开 **技能中心**，匿名浏览、搜索、查看技能详情，并管理安装、升级和卸载；对话中也可搜索和明确请求安装技能。插件内置本地安装核心，无需另装 SkillHub CLI。

`0.2.0` 新增来源可核验的搜索安装状态：广场卡片和对话工具可识别当前来源的受管理安装版本、用户/项目范围及异常记录；对话保留查询时快照。未发现本来源记录不代表其他市场或手工安装不存在，文件存在也不代表 DSH 已启用该技能。按来源、命名空间和技能标识匹配；不按同名目录认领其他来源技能。

`0.2.1` 缺省连接 `https://skill.xfyun.cn`；显式空串或仅空白仍表示断开，已有自定义地址保留。插件不继承 CLI 的默认地址或凭证。

`0.4.0` 使用独立标签 `dsh-v0.4.0`，提供技能案例与原生输入框衔接、对话管理已安装技能及按安装位置独立维护版本。保留 `0.3.1` 的双 RC 兼容范围。公开可用状态以 npm 为准；本地构建的 tarball 可按下文独立验证。

## 使用已安装技能

## 构建与打包

在仓库根目录执行：

```sh
cd cli
bun install --frozen-lockfile
cd ../plugins/dsh
bun install --frozen-lockfile
bun run check
npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts
```

`dsh-typert-generator` 固定在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 以生成两个宿主共用的 RPC 契约；其他 DSH 开发依赖按 `0.2.1-rc.2` 类型检查。生成器版本不是宿主版本绕过条件。

检查通过后，将候选包保存到仓库外的独立目录：

```sh
npm pack --ignore-scripts --pack-destination /absolute/path/to/candidate-output
```

输出目录须先创建。`--dry-run` 不生成 tarball；实际安装使用生成的 `.tgz`。保留每次候选包及其校验值，不覆盖已经用于验收或回退的包。

本版沿用以下完整组合，不接受交叉混装或未列出的补丁版本。DSH 主包中的 `~` 依赖不会因主包版本固定而自动锁定；以实际宿主解析结果为准。

| 组合 | Cordis | Loader | Include | Timer |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 保留基线 | `4.0.4` | `1.0.5` | `1.0.9` | `1.1.6` |
| 新补丁组合 | `4.0.5` | `1.0.6` | `1.0.10` | `1.1.7` |

## 从旧版本升级

`0.4.0` 使用按安装位置记录版本的库存 v2。插件仍内置安装核心，无需为了使用插件单独安装 CLI；如果同一用户还使用 SkillHub CLI 管理这些技能，先将这些 CLI 升级到 `0.2.0`，再升级插件，并停止旧版 CLI 的定时或后台写入。先用 `npm view @astron-team/skillhub@0.2.0 version` 确认可用，再使用 `npm install -g @astron-team/skillhub@0.2.0`，确认 `skillhub version`，再执行上面的精确插件版本安装命令。

读取旧库存不迁移；首次写入 v2 前，在库存同目录保存经字节核对的 `inventory.v1.<sha256>.backup.json`。同一技能的用户与项目副本可保留不同版本。旧 CLI 与 v2 库存混写不受支持；已分位置更新后，不能只恢复旧库存文件或降级插件来回退，必须同时核对实际技能文件、安装元数据和操作记录。

案例由作者随技能包提供固定文件 `.skillhub/examples.json`，安装后保持相同位置，跟随技能版本和指纹，不创建另一个全局案例副本。无案例时使用自定义任务；无效声明按普通文件保留，不提供错误的案例入口。

## 配置技能来源

进入 DSH **Plugins/插件 → @astron-team/skillhub-dsh → SkillHub 设置**。

1. 在“技能来源”填写 **Registry 地址**，使用实例的 HTTP(S) 基础地址，可包含部署子路径；不要填写 API 路由、凭证、查询参数或片段。
2. 点击“测试连接”，使用当前草稿地址测试，不保存配置。结果显示公开目录可读或仅支持基础搜索及耗时；最长等待 10 秒，失败或超时可重试。修改地址后清除旧测试结果，连接成功不代表技能下载或所有可选接口可用。
3. 在“详情标签”设置版本、安全审核及评论的显示方式。
4. 点击“保存配置”，看到“配置已保存”后进入侧栏“技能中心”搜索公开测试技能。

“已配置”只表示 Host 已保存非空来源，不代表连通测试成功。空地址表示断开来源；“重置修改”恢复当前 Host 配置快照，不发起网络重载或保存。只读连接不可编辑。若保存发生 revision 冲突，先重置修改，再基于当前值编辑。

| 字段 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `registryUrl` | Registry 基础地址；缺省为 `https://skill.xfyun.cn`；显式空串或仅空白断开，不回退；自定义值保留 |
| `detailTabs.versions` | 版本历史显示策略 |
| `detailTabs.securityAudit` | 安全审核显示策略 |
| `detailTabs.reviews` | 只读评论显示策略 |

三项策略均支持 `auto`（自动检测）、`show`（显示）、`hide`（隐藏）。自动检测按实际匿名读取能力决定展示；显示不会放开服务端权限；隐藏不请求对应模块。当前审核接口不允许匿名读取，不能把不可访问显示为审核通过。未上线评论的 SaaS 可先隐藏评论。

## 使用流程

- **浏览技能**：搜索、服务端排序、真实标签筛选、点击加载更多。新目录接口每批 12 项；旧来源首批 404/405 可回退受限搜索，明确提示不支持分页和排序。选中标签失败不会退回未过滤结果。
- **技能详情**：查看文档、版本和可选模块；可“查看此版本”后确认安装指定的可下载版本。已有其他版本时保留覆盖保护，不执行降级。
- **已安装**：按来源、范围和关键词查看本地记录。详情右侧“版本与更新”提供重新读取及检查更新；升级与卸载只影响选中的一个安装位置，其他位置的版本保持不变。目录缺失时可单独确认清理失效记录。
- **对话搜索**：`astron_skillhub_search` 只搜索，不安装或执行技能。结果提供明确详情动作；详情抽屉可确认安装。
- **对话安装**：用户明确要求安装唯一搜索结果时，不必先打开详情。`astron_skillhub_install` 核验搜索时的精确版本和快照；接受 `selectionRef` 或完整坐标，二者互斥，范围为 `user`/`project`。过期或歧义引用拒绝执行，不改装当前 latest。

本地操作需要活动会话，Host 据此解析可信用户目录和工作区。远程 Host 的文件安装在 Host 所在机器，不在浏览器机器。插件不提供登录、评论提交或权限管理。

安装受理、文件完成、DSH 发现及模型实际使用是不同状态。安装卡主区展示结果，展开“安装记录”可查看核验、当前库存和原操作信息。历史完成不代表当前仍安装该版本，也不代表模型已执行。Host 重启后的历史搜索需要主动“重新查看详情”重新核验，不能恢复旧引用的写权限。

## 验证候选包

从 `plugins/dsh` 执行仓库提供的隔离 Host 冒烟脚本：

```sh
node scripts/smoke-native-host.mjs --artifact /absolute/path/to/candidate.tgz --report /absolute/path/to/host-smoke-summary.json --dsh-version 0.2.1-rc.2
```

脚本使用隔离 Web Profile 验证候选安装与 Host 加载；不调用模型，不替代 UI 或完整技能生命周期验收。浏览器和文件事务探针见源码中的 [集成验证指南](test/integration/README.md)。

对公开测试 Registry 执行匿名契约检查：

```sh
bun run probe:registry --registry 'https://registry.example' --namespace 'demo' --slug 'test-skill' --version '1.0.0' --output /absolute/path/to/registry-report.json
```

替换示例地址和精确版本，使用新的输出文件。脚本检查搜索、解析、元信息、说明、可选模块及归档指纹，归档仅在临时目录解包，不安装或执行技能。该探针不替代目录分页、标签、排序和真实 DSH 页面测试，后者须另外验收。必需项失败产生非零退出码；审核 HTTP 成功不等于公开审核 schema 已通过验证。

人工至少核验来源保存/重置、搜索和详情、用户/项目安装、更新及卸载、历史结果、深浅主题与窄屏、失败重试和来源变更保护。模型验收需单独确定模型配置和调用预算，不能以页面测试代替。

## 更新、回退与缓存

1. 停止提交新操作，等待已受理操作结束；待恢复事务先在原兼容环境处理。
2. 保存当前 tarball，停止使用该 Profile 的 Host。
3. 使用上面的 `plugin ... add` 命令安装目标 tarball，保持 Profile、来源、会话和模型配置不变。
4. 重新启动 Host，重新进入其有效访问入口；浏览器仍显示旧 UI 时进行强制刷新（Windows：Ctrl+Shift+R）。
5. 检查技能中心、配置、现有安装记录和历史查询，再执行测试技能操作。

强制刷新只更新浏览器资源，不会重载 Host 的 Node 模块。依赖变化必须完整重启 Host；禁用/启用插件不能代替依赖重载。官方 RC.2 的 Host 同端口重启可能使原标签页空白，不能承诺无缝重连；保留原操作记录，用有效入口重新进入，不重复提交安装。

回退使用已保留、已验证兼容的 tarball，按相同步骤执行。开发候选替换验证不构成跨正式版本日志兼容承诺。未知日志格式、待恢复事务不能通过删除日志或重装包绕过。插件回退与技能版本降级不是同一功能。

临时停用可在 DSH 插件页关闭本包开关；启用后等待“技能中心”恢复。移除包使用：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile skillhub-test remove @astron-team/skillhub-dsh
```

`remove` 不接受 `--ignore-scripts`。禁用或移除插件不等于卸载技能，不删除技能目录、inventory 或操作日志。操作结果未知时查询原请求；需要恢复时使用界面的“核验并恢复”，不要发起新请求替代恢复。

## 服务端同步与发布

插件 Host 调用匿名 Registry HTTP API；本地安装事务在 Host 内完成，不需要 SaaS 新增操作用户文件系统的安装接口。开源先定义和验证契约，再将缺失的路径、字段、匿名策略和测试同步到 SaaS。公开 npm `0.2.0` 已对 `https://skill.xfyun.cn` 完成目录、搜索、文档、版本选择和固定版本项目安装及文件/指纹、库存、DSH 发现核验；各版本的构建产物与公开包分别验收。日期格式等无法可靠排序的非 SemVer 版本继续阻断自动升级，不显示可执行升级入口；这不影响已验证的固定版本首次安装。SaaS 技能的真实模型执行尚未验收。详细要求见 [Registry 契约](../../openspec/changes/add-dsh-native-plugin/registry-api-contract.md)。

插件独立使用 `dsh-v<version>` tag，不复用 CLI 或服务镜像发布。`check-dsh-plugin.yml` 配置 Linux/macOS/Windows × Node 24.2.0/当前 Node 24 的普通干净安装检查，并额外保留旧 Cordis 组合的隔离 Host 回归；`release-dsh-plugin.yml` 手动触发，默认只产出候选包。发布需正式版本、可发布 manifest、候选验收及明确发布授权；配置了环境保护规则时还须完成相应审批。版本更新需显式提交，npm 发布需明确授权后运行专用工作流。

具体部署、发布后检查与回退清单见 [发布指南](../../openspec/changes/add-dsh-native-plugin/release-guide.md)，变化见 [发布说明](../../openspec/changes/add-dsh-native-plugin/release-notes.md)。上述 OpenSpec 与测试链接面向源码仓库，不包含在 npm tarball 中。

### 市场交互与安装管理

市场卡片支持点击进入详情及独立安装、卸载、检查更新/升级操作；多范围记录先选择管理目标。用户明确要求安装后，未指定范围默认当前用户；明确指定当前项目时安装到项目。市场卡片的安装按钮也直接打开确认弹窗；默认预选当前用户，项目级位于高级选项，但不自动提交。用户后续明确范围也可发起新调用。详情隐藏完整首部元数据，保留安全 Markdown；公开读取缓存 60 秒，写入仍重新核验。版本 Tab 请求 `downloadableOnly=true`，需要本次开源后端契约；SaaS 尚需单独同步和验收。

安装确认后弹窗保留并向右展开：左侧固定技能、版本和范围，右侧展示简洁的实际进度与结果；窄屏上下排列。处理中不模拟百分比，关闭窗口不取消已提交的安装。

安装管理以当前库存为准，历史安装成功不代表目前仍已安装。已有记录时默认选中对应范围，并提供卸载入口；“仅此项目”对应项目目录，“所有项目”对应当前 Host 的当前用户级目录。切换范围不会自动安装；卸载后可再次明确安装。

市场卡片、已安装列表和详情中的卸载可直接打开确认弹窗，不再为卸载跳转到另一详情页。确认框保留技能、版本、所选范围和影响说明；打开仅核验，确认才执行。取消与 Esc 不卸载，过期计划和异常安装仍由原事务校验阻断。

SkillHub is a self-hosted platform that gives teams a private,
governed place to share agent skills. Publish a skill package, push
it to a namespace, and let others find it through search or
install it via CLI. Built for on-premise deployment behind your
firewall, with the same polish you'd expect from a public registry.

> ⭐ If SkillHub fits your team, **star** the repo to help other teams find it, and **Watch → Custom → Releases** to get notified when a new version ships.

## Share Great Skills

Great Skills become more valuable when they are shared. If you have a Skill that has
proved useful in real work or everyday life, share it with the SkillHub community and
help grow an open, practical Skill ecosystem. We welcome Skills for daily life, office
work, learning and research, travel and events, content creation, data analysis, and
software development—not only engineering workflows.

High-quality community contributions may join the curated starter collection, making new
SkillHub deployments useful from day one. You do not need to finish the full adaptation
before joining in: [open an issue](https://github.com/iflytek/skillhub/issues/new/choose)
with the Skill's source and the problem it solves, or submit a PR by following the
[Skill sharing guide](./builtin-skills/README.md).

## Documentation

- 📖 **[User Guide](https://iflytek.github.io/skillhub/)** — Skill publishing, search, CLI usage and other user guides
- 🛠️ **[Developer Docs](https://zread.ai/iflytek/skillhub)** — Architecture, API reference, local development, deployment and operations
- 🐍 **[Python Examples](./examples/python)** — Search, download, and publish skills from Python via the REST API

## Governance and Safety

- **[Privacy and Data Governance](docs/PRIVACY_AND_DATA_GOVERNANCE.md)** —
  Data categories, operator responsibilities, retention, portability, and incident
  handling for public and self-hosted instances
- **[Content Safety](docs/CONTENT_SAFETY.md)** — Package safety expectations,
  review and reporting controls, appeals, and child-safety responsibilities
- **[Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)** — Community standards and the private
  reporting channel
- **[Security Policy](https://github.com/iflytek/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md)** —
  Private vulnerability reporting and coordinated disclosure

## Highlights

- **Self-Hosted & Private** — Deploy on your own infrastructure.
  Keep proprietary skills behind your firewall with full data
  sovereignty. One `make dev-all` command to get running locally.
- **Publish & Version** — Upload agent skill packages with semantic
  versioning, custom tags (`beta`, `stable`), and automatic
  `latest` tracking.
- **Discover** — Full-text search with filters by namespace,
  downloads, ratings, and recency. Visibility rules ensure
  users only see what they're authorized to.
- **Team Namespaces** — Organize skills under team or global scopes.
  Each namespace has its own members, roles (Owner / Admin /
  Member), and publishing policies.
- **Review & Governance** — Team admins review within their namespace;
  platform admins gate promotions to the global scope. Governance
  actions are audit-logged for compliance.
- **Social Features** — Star skills, rate them, and track downloads.
  Build a community around your organization's best practices.
- **Account Merging** — Consolidate multiple OAuth identities and
  API tokens under a single user account.
- **API Token Management** — Generate scoped tokens for CLI and
  programmatic access with prefix-based secure hashing.
- **CLI-First** — Native REST API plus a compatibility layer for
  existing ClawHub-style registry clients. Native CLI APIs are the
  primary supported path while protocol compatibility continues to
  expand.
- **Pluggable Storage** — Local filesystem for development, S3 /
  MinIO for production. Swap via config.
- **Internationalization** — Multi-language support with i18next.

## Quick Start

Start the full local stack with:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://imageless.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/runtime.sh | sh -s -- up
```

The default command pulls the `latest` stable release images. Use `--version edge` if you want the newest build from `main`.

**Configure public URL (recommended for production):**

```bash
curl -fsSL https://imageless.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/runtime.sh | sh -s -- up --public-url https://skillhub.your-company.com
```

The `--public-url` parameter sets the public access URL for your SkillHub instance. This ensures:
- CLI install commands show the correct registry URL
- Agent setup instructions display the correct skill.md URL
- OAuth callbacks and device auth links work properly

**For users in China (Aliyun mirror):**

```bash
curl -fsSL https://imageless.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/runtime.sh | sh -s -- up --aliyun --public-url https://skillhub.your-company.com --version latest
```

Keep the existing runtime home when rerunning or updating the deployment. The
runtime script reuses its `.env.release` file; deleting the directory discards
your custom configuration, including the public URL and generated anonymous
download cookie secret.

If deployment runs into problems, inspect the `ps` and `logs` lifecycle commands
printed by the runtime script, then retry `up` with the same runtime home. If you
intentionally want a fresh configuration, back up `.env.release` before clearing
the runtime home.

```bash

# Or run directly

# Login
```

By default, `make dev-all` starts the backend with the `local` profile.
In that mode, local development keeps the mock-auth users below and also
creates a password-based bootstrap admin account by default:

- `local-user` for normal publishing and namespace operations
- `local-admin` with `SUPER_ADMIN` for review and admin flows

### Container Runtime

Published runtime images are built by GitHub Actions and pushed to GHCR.
This is the supported path for anyone who wants a ready-to-use local
environment without building the backend or frontend on their machine.
Published server and web images target `linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`, and
`linux/riscv64`; the scanner image currently targets `linux/amd64` and
`linux/arm64`.

**Quick deployment with curl:**

```bash
# Default (GHCR images)
curl -fsSL https://imageless.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/runtime.sh | sh -s -- up --public-url https://skillhub.your-company.com

# Aliyun mirror (recommended for users in China)
curl -fsSL https://imageless.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/runtime.sh | sh -s -- up --aliyun --public-url https://skillhub.your-company.com --version latest

```

**Deployment parameters:**

| Parameter | Description | Example |
|-----------|-------------|---------|
| `--public-url <url>` | Public access URL (recommended) | `--public-url https://skill.example.com` |
| `--version <tag>` | Specific image tag | `--version v0.2.0` |
| `--aliyun` | Use Aliyun mirror (China) | `--aliyun` |
| `--home <dir>` | Runtime directory | `--home /opt/skillhub` |
| `--no-scanner` | Disable security scanner | `--no-scanner` |

> **Important**: Configure `--public-url` for production deployments to ensure CLI install commands and Agent setup instructions display the correct URLs.

For sub-path deployments, keep the public URL and runtime base path aligned in
`.env.release`: set `SKILLHUB_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://skill.example.com/skillhub`,
`SKILLHUB_WEB_BASE_PATH=/skillhub/`, and `SKILLHUB_WEB_API_BASE_URL=/skillhub`.

**Manual deployment:**

1. Copy the runtime environment template.
2. Pick an image tag.
3. Start the stack with Docker Compose.

```bash
cp .env.release.example .env.release
```

Recommended image tags:

- `SKILLHUB_VERSION=latest` for the latest stable release (default)
- `SKILLHUB_VERSION=edge` for the latest `main` build
- `SKILLHUB_VERSION=vX.Y.Z` for a fixed release

Start the runtime:

```bash
make validate-release-config
docker compose --env-file .env.release -f compose.release.yml up -d
```

Then open:

- Web UI: `SKILLHUB_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` 对应的地址
- Backend API: `http://localhost:8080`

Stop it with:

```bash
docker compose --env-file .env.release -f compose.release.yml down
```

The runtime stack uses its own Compose project name, so it does not
collide with containers from `make dev-all`.

The production Compose stack now defaults to the `docker` profile only.
It does not enable local mock auth. The release template (`.env.release.example`)
enables the bootstrap admin by default, so zero-config quickstart via
`runtime.sh` works out of the box:

- username: `admin`
- password: `ChangeMe!2026`

- set `SKILLHUB_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` to the final HTTPS entrypoint
- if the service is published under a sub-path such as `/skillhub/`, set

- keep PostgreSQL / Redis bound to `127.0.0.1`

## SkillHub and the Agent Skills Ecosystem

SkillHub is a **registry and governance platform** — not a skill collection.
It is complementary to open skill catalogs such as
[`anthropics/skills`](https://github.com/anthropics/skills): that repository
popularized the **Agent Skill format** (a `SKILL.md` with `name` / `description`
frontmatter plus supporting files) and ships a curated set of example skills.
SkillHub is where your organization **hosts, versions, governs, and distributes**
those skills privately.

|  | [`anthropics/skills`](https://github.com/anthropics/skills) | **SkillHub** |
|---|---|---|
| What it is | A curated collection of example Agent Skills + the format spec | A self-hosted registry & governance platform for skills |
| Layer | Content — the skills themselves | Infrastructure — hosting, versioning, discovery, access control |
| Hosting | Public GitHub repository | Your own infrastructure, behind your firewall |
| Versioning | Git history | Semantic versions, tags (`beta` / `stable`), `latest` tracking |
| Access control | Public | Namespaces, RBAC, review & audit logging |
| Distribution | Clone / copy files | Full-text search + CLI install |

Because SkillHub speaks the same `SKILL.md` format, skills from `anthropics/skills`
— or any Agent Skill folder — publish straight into your registry:

```bash
# Grab a skill from an open collection...
git clone https://github.com/anthropics/skills

# ...and publish it into your private SkillHub registry
export SKILLHUB_REGISTRY=https://skillhub.your-company.com
export SKILLHUB_TOKEN=YOUR_API_TOKEN
npx @astron-team/skillhub@latest publish ./skills/<category>/<skill-name>
```

> ⚖️ **Licensing**: honor each skill's own license when republishing. Most skills in
> `anthropics/skills` are Apache 2.0, but the document skills (DOCX/PDF/PPTX/XLSX) are
> source-available rather than open source — check the skill's `LICENSE` before redistributing.

**In short: use collections like `anthropics/skills` for content, and SkillHub to
distribute it across your organization under governance.**

## Usage with Agent Platforms

SkillHub works as a skill registry backend for several agent platforms. Point any of the clients below at your SkillHub instance to publish, discover, and install skills.

### [OpenClaw](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw)

[OpenClaw](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw) is an open-source agent skill CLI. Configure it to use your SkillHub endpoint as the registry:

```bash
# Configure registry URL
export CLAWHUB_REGISTRY=https://skillhub.your-company.com

# Authenticate once if needed
clawhub login --token YOUR_API_TOKEN

# Search and install skills
npx clawhub search email
npx clawhub install my-skill
npx clawhub install my-namespace--my-skill

# Publishing uses the first-party SkillHub CLI
export SKILLHUB_REGISTRY=https://skillhub.your-company.com
export SKILLHUB_TOKEN=YOUR_API_TOKEN
npx @astron-team/skillhub@latest publish ./my-skill --namespace my-space
```

`my-space--my-skill` is the canonical compat slug. SkillHub parses it as
namespace `my-space` plus skill slug `my-skill`.

ClawHub compatibility covers search, inspection, and installation. Its publish
protocol is not compatible with SkillHub; use the first-party CLI shown above.

> 💡 **Tip**: The above commands are not only applicable to OpenClaw, but also to other CLI Coding Agents or Agent assistants by specifying the installation directory (`--dir`). For example: `npx clawhub --dir ~/.claude/skills install my-skill`

📖 **[Complete OpenClaw Integration Guide →](./docs/openclaw-integration.md)**

### [Hermes Agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent)

[Hermes Agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent) uses the standard `SKILL.md` format and recursively discovers skills under `$HERMES_HOME/skills/`. Use SkillHub CLI's explicit `--dir` option to install a complete SkillHub package into Hermes without a registry adapter, then verify it with `hermes skills list`.

📖 **[Complete Hermes Agent Integration Guide →](./docs/hermes-integration-en.md)**

### [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) discovers standard `SKILL.md` packages from `.dsh/skills` and the shared `.agents/skills` roots. Install directly into its native user directory with the first-party SkillHub CLI:

```bash
skillhub install my-skill --agent dsh --scope user
```

Project-scoped installs use `<repository>/.dsh/skills`; run them from the repository root. dsh watches its skill roots, so newly installed skills are discovered without restarting the process.

📖 **[Complete DeepSeek Harness Integration Guide →](./docs/dsh-integration-en.md)**

### [HarnessClaw Engine](https://github.com/harnessclaw/harnessclaw-engine)

[HarnessClaw Engine](https://github.com/harnessclaw/harnessclaw-engine) is a Go LLM programming assistant engine that exposes its capabilities over WebSocket. It loads skills from `SKILL.md` files with YAML frontmatter and parameter substitution, scanning each configured directory for `skill-name/SKILL.md` (default `~/.harnessclaw/workspace/skills/`, with earlier directories taking priority on name conflicts). Install a SkillHub package straight into that directory with the CLI's `--dir` option, no registry adapter required:

```bash
npx clawhub --dir ~/.harnessclaw/workspace/skills install my-skill
```
### [AstronClaw](https://agent.xfyun.cn/astron-claw)

[AstronClaw](https://agent.xfyun.cn/astron-claw) is a cloud AI assistant built on OpenClaw's core capabilities, providing 24/7 online service through enterprise platforms like WeChat Work, DingTalk, and Feishu. It features a built-in skill system with over 130 official skills. You can connect it to a self-hosted SkillHub registry to enable one-click skill installation, search repository, dialogue-based automatic installation, and even custom skills management within your organization.

### [Loomy](https://loomy.xunfei.cn/)

[Loomy](https://loomy.xunfei.cn/) is a desktop AI work partner focusing on real office scenarios. It integrates deeply with local files and system tools to build efficient automated workflows for individuals and small teams. By connecting Loomy to your SkillHub registry, you can easily discover and install organization-specific skills to enhance your local desktop automation and productivity.

### [astron-agent](https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent)

[astron-agent](https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent) is the iFlytek Astron agent framework. Skills stored in SkillHub can be referenced and loaded by astron-agent, enabling a governed, versioned skill lifecycle from development to production.

import type { ConversationSearchContext } from './search-tool.js';

export interface SelectionScope { sessionId: string; cwd: string; sourceRevision: string }
export interface SelectionSnapshot {
  namespace: string; slug: string; version: string; versionId: number; fingerprint: string;
}
type Candidate = SelectionScope & { callId: string; namespace: string; slug: string; version: string };
type Verified = { detailToken: string; snapshot: SelectionSnapshot };
type Search = Candidate & { kind: 'search'; pending?: string; viewed?: string; identity?: string; ambiguous?: boolean; verified?: Verified; verifying?: Promise<Verified> };
type Fixed = Candidate & { kind: 'fixed'; parent: string; detailToken: string; snapshot: SelectionSnapshot; viewed: boolean };

/** Host-only references: opening a detail does not make it an acknowledged selection. */
export class ConversationSelections {
  private readonly records = new Map<string, Search | Fixed>();
  clear(): void { this.records.clear(); }

  add(context: ConversationSearchContext & { sourceRevision: string }, coordinate: Pick<SelectionSnapshot, 'namespace' | 'slug' | 'version'>): string {
    return this.put({ ...context, ...coordinate, kind: 'search' });
  }

  read(reference: string, scope: SelectionScope): Readonly<Candidate> {
    const { sessionId, cwd, sourceRevision, callId, namespace, slug, version } = this.lookup(reference, scope);
    return { sessionId, cwd, sourceRevision, callId, namespace, slug, version };
  }

  private lookup(reference: string, scope: SelectionScope): Search | Fixed {
    const record = this.records.get(reference);
    if (!record || record.sessionId !== scope.sessionId || record.cwd !== scope.cwd || record.sourceRevision !== scope.sourceRevision) this.stale();
    return record;
  }

  stage(reference: string, scope: SelectionScope, detailToken: string, snapshot: SelectionSnapshot): string {
    const candidate = this.lookup(reference, scope);
    const parentRef = candidate.kind === 'fixed' ? candidate.parent : reference;
    const parent = this.lookup(parentRef, scope);
    if (parent.kind !== 'search' || snapshot.namespace !== candidate.namespace || snapshot.slug !== candidate.slug || snapshot.version !== candidate.version) this.stale();
    const fixed = this.put({ sessionId: parent.sessionId, cwd: parent.cwd, callId: parent.callId,
      sourceRevision: parent.sourceRevision, namespace: snapshot.namespace, slug: snapshot.slug, version: snapshot.version,
      kind: 'fixed', parent: parentRef, detailToken, snapshot: { ...snapshot }, viewed: false });
    parent.pending = fixed;
    return fixed;
  }

  acknowledge(reference: string, scope: SelectionScope, detailToken: string): boolean {
    const candidate = this.lookup(reference, scope);
    const fixedRef = candidate.kind === 'search' ? candidate.pending : reference;
    if (!fixedRef) this.stale();
    const fixed = this.lookup(fixedRef, scope);
    if (fixed.kind !== 'fixed' || fixed.detailToken !== detailToken) this.stale();
    const parent = this.lookup(fixed.parent, scope);
    if (parent.kind !== 'search' || parent.pending !== fixedRef) this.stale();
    const identity = JSON.stringify([fixed.snapshot.version, fixed.snapshot.versionId, fixed.snapshot.fingerprint]);
    if (parent.identity !== undefined && parent.identity !== identity) parent.ambiguous = true;
    parent.identity = identity;
    parent.viewed = fixedRef;
    fixed.viewed = true;
    return true;
  }

  /** Installation adapters must use this exact snapshot and revalidate it before committing. */
  resolve(reference: string, scope: SelectionScope): { selectionRef: string; detailToken: string; snapshot: SelectionSnapshot } {
    const candidate = this.lookup(reference, scope);
    if (candidate.kind === 'search' && (candidate.ambiguous || !candidate.viewed)) this.stale();
    const fixedRef = candidate.kind === 'search' ? candidate.viewed! : reference;
    const fixed = this.lookup(fixedRef, scope);
    if (fixed.kind !== 'fixed' || !fixed.viewed) this.stale();
    this.lookup(fixed.parent, scope);
    return { selectionRef: fixedRef, detailToken: fixed.detailToken, snapshot: { ...fixed.snapshot } };
  }

  /** A direct install verifies a search candidate without pretending its detail was displayed. */
  async resolveForInstall(reference: string, scope: SelectionScope,
    verify: (candidate: Readonly<Candidate>) => Promise<Verified>): Promise<Verified> {
    const candidate = this.lookup(reference, scope);
    if (candidate.kind === 'fixed' || candidate.viewed || candidate.ambiguous) return this.resolve(reference, scope);
    if (!candidate.verifying && !candidate.verified) {
      candidate.verifying = verify(this.read(reference, scope));
    }
    try {
      const verified = candidate.verified ?? await candidate.verifying!;
      if (this.lookup(reference, scope) !== candidate) this.stale();
      // A detail acknowledged during the request takes precedence, including ambiguity checks.
      if (candidate.viewed || candidate.ambiguous) return this.resolve(reference, scope);
      if (verified.snapshot.namespace !== candidate.namespace || verified.snapshot.slug !== candidate.slug
        || verified.snapshot.version !== candidate.version || !verified.snapshot.fingerprint) this.stale();
      candidate.verified = { detailToken: verified.detailToken, snapshot: { ...verified.snapshot } };
      return { detailToken: verified.detailToken, snapshot: { ...verified.snapshot } };
    } finally {
      candidate.verifying = undefined;
    }
  }

  private put(record: Search | Fixed): string {
    if (this.records.size >= 400) this.records.delete(this.records.keys().next().value!);
    const reference = randomUUID();
    this.records.set(reference, record);
    return reference;
  }
  private stale(): never {
    throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Reopen and select the skill detail in this conversation.', { retryable: false });
  }
}

  submitInstall(request: NativeOperationRequest, prepare: () => Promise<PreparedNativeInstall>): Promise<NativeOperation | undefined> {

    const input = { ...request, parameters: { ...request.parameters } };

      const current = await resolveInstalledPath({ scope: item.scope, cwd, fs: fs!, signal: combined });
      readyContext();
      if (current.root !== target.root || current.dshHome !== target.dshHome) {
        throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Installed target changed.', { retryable: false });
      }
      const inspected = await runtime!.inspectRemoval(identity, current);
      readyContext(); latest.valid();
      if (!isDeepStrictEqual(inspected, baseline)) return { status: 'blocked', reason: 'files-changed' };
      if (runtime!.getStatus().state !== 'ready' || runtime!.getStatus().pendingOperations > 0) {
        return { status: 'blocked', reason: 'operation-pending' };
      }
      const winner = await skills.get(observed.skill.name, { scope: agent!, cwd, signal: combined });
      readyContext();
      if (!winner) return { status: 'blocked', reason: 'skill-unavailable' };
      if (!sameDshSkill(winner, observed.skill, item.targetPath)) return { status: 'blocked', reason: 'skill-shadowed' };
      const finalBaseline = await runtime!.inspectRemoval(identity, current);
      readyContext(); latest.valid();
      if (!isDeepStrictEqual(finalBaseline, baseline)) return { status: 'blocked', reason: 'files-changed' };
      if (runtime!.getStatus().state !== 'ready' || runtime!.getStatus().pendingOperations > 0) {
        return { status: 'blocked', reason: 'operation-pending' };
      }
      return { status: 'ready', name: observed.skill.name, version: item.version, scope: item.scope, examples };
    } catch (error) {
      readyContext();
      if (error instanceof RemoteError) throw error;
      return { status: 'blocked', reason: 'skill-unavailable' };
    }
  }

  private async checkUpdateForVersion(sourceRevision: string, itemKey: string, version: string | undefined, signal: AbortSignal, agentId?: string): Promise<InstalledUpdateCheck> {
    const { item, valid } = await this.readInstalledItem(sourceRevision, itemKey, signal, agentId);
    const base = { currentVersion: item.version, candidateVersion: null, checkedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
    if (item.state !== 'present') return { ...base, state: 'blocked', reason: 'local-record-unverified' };
    let candidate;
    try {
      candidate = await this.readSource(sourceRevision, signal, (registry, signal) => registry.resolve(item.namespace, item.slug, version, signal));
    } catch (error) {
      signal.throwIfAborted(); valid();
      return { ...base, state: 'unavailable', reason: installationFailureCode(error) };
    }
    if (version !== undefined && candidate.version !== version) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Selected version changed.', { retryable: false });
    const after = await this.readInstalledItem(sourceRevision, itemKey, signal, agentId);
    if (after.item.state !== item.state || after.item.fingerprint !== item.fingerprint) {
      throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Installed record changed during update check.', { retryable: false });
    }
    const assessment = await this.localRuntime!.assessUpdate(item, candidate);
    after.valid();
    signal.throwIfAborted();
    this.lifetime.signal.throwIfAborted();
    return { ...assessment, checkedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
  }

  private async prepareUpgradeForVersion(sourceRevision: string, itemKey: string, version: string | undefined, signal: AbortSignal, agentId?: string): Promise<UpgradePlanView> {
    const { item, valid, agent, runtime, fs } = await this.readInstalledItem(sourceRevision, itemKey, signal, agentId);
    const combined = AbortSignal.any([signal, this.lifetime.signal]);
    const context = this.selectionScope(agent!);
    const base: UpgradePlanView = { hostInstanceId: runtime!.getStatus().hostInstanceId!, status: 'blocked', reason: '', planId: null, expiresAt: null,
      currentVersion: item.version, candidateVersion: null, targets: [] };
    if (runtime!.getStatus().pendingOperations > 0) return { ...base, reason: 'recovery-required' };
    if (item.state !== 'present') return { ...base, reason: 'local-record-unverified' };
    const policy = agent!.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent!.session });
    const roots = [await resolveInstallationPath({ scope: item.scope, cwd: context.cwd, fs: fs!, policy, signal: combined })];
    const baseline = await runtime!.inspectUpgrade({ registry: this.getContext().registryUrl,
      namespace: item.namespace, slug: item.slug, version: item.version }, roots);
    valid(); combined.throwIfAborted();
    if (baseline.status === 'blocked') return { ...base, reason: baseline.reason };
    const candidate = await this.readSource(sourceRevision, combined,
      (registry, signal) => registry.resolve(item.namespace, item.slug, version, signal));
    if (version !== undefined && candidate.version !== version) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Selected version changed.', { retryable: false });
    const assessment = await runtime!.assessUpdate(item, candidate);
    valid(); combined.throwIfAborted();
    if (assessment.state !== 'upgradable') return { ...base,
      status: assessment.state === 'current' ? 'unchanged' : 'blocked', reason: assessment.reason, candidateVersion: candidate.version };
    for (const target of baseline.targets) {
      const current = await resolveInstallationPath({ scope: target.scope, cwd: context.cwd, fs: fs!,
        policy: agent!.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent!.session }), signal: combined });
      if (current.root !== target.root) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Upgrade target changed.', { retryable: false });
    }
    valid(); combined.throwIfAborted();
    const plan = this.upgradePlans.issue(context, { baseline, candidate });
    return { ...base, ...plan, status: 'ready', reason: 'newer-version', candidateVersion: candidate.version,
      targets: baseline.targets.map(target => ({ scope: target.scope, path: target.path })) };
  }

  private async prepareUninstallForAgent(sourceRevision: string, itemKey: string, signal: AbortSignal, agentId?: string): Promise<UninstallPlanView> {
    const { item, valid, agent, runtime, fs } = await this.readInstalledItem(sourceRevision, itemKey, signal, agentId);
    const combined = AbortSignal.any([signal, this.lifetime.signal]);
    const context = this.selectionScope(agent!);
    const base: UninstallPlanView = { hostInstanceId: runtime!.getStatus().hostInstanceId!, status: 'blocked', reason: '',
      kind: null, planId: null, expiresAt: null, currentVersion: item.version, target: null };
    if (runtime!.getStatus().pendingOperations > 0) return { ...base, reason: 'recovery-required' };
    if (!['present', 'missing'].includes(item.state)) return { ...base, reason: 'local-record-unverified' };
    const policy = agent!.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent!.session });
    const target = await resolveInstallationPath({ scope: item.scope, cwd: context.cwd, fs: fs!, policy, signal: combined });
    const baseline = await runtime!.inspectRemoval({ registry: this.getContext().registryUrl,
      namespace: item.namespace, slug: item.slug, version: item.version }, target);
    valid(); combined.throwIfAborted();
    if (baseline.status === 'blocked') return { ...base, reason: baseline.reason };
    const currentPolicy = agent!.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent!.session });
    const current = await resolveInstallationPath({ scope: item.scope, cwd: context.cwd, fs: fs!, policy: currentPolicy, signal: combined });
    if (current.root !== target.root || current.dshHome !== target.dshHome) {
      throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Removal target changed.', { retryable: false });
    }
    const paths = [target.root, baseline.target.path];
    if (baseline.kind === 'uninstall') paths.push(join(dirname(target.root), '.skillhub-trash'));
    await assertRemovalMutation(target.root, item.slug, randomUUID(), paths, currentPolicy);
    valid(); combined.throwIfAborted();
    const plan = this.removalPlans.issue(context, baseline);
    return { ...base, ...plan, status: 'ready', kind: baseline.kind, reason: baseline.kind,
      target: { scope: baseline.target.scope, path: baseline.target.path } };
  }

  /** Opaque references are stable within a Host and bind the full trusted record snapshot. */
  private installedItemKey(sessionId: string, cwd: string, sourceRevision: string, item: InstalledProjectionItem): string {
    return createHmac('sha256', this.installedReferenceKey).update(JSON.stringify([
      sessionId, cwd, sourceRevision, item.scope, item.namespace, item.slug, item.version,
      item.targetPath, item.fingerprint ?? null, item.state, item.recordRevision ?? null,
    ])).digest('base64url');
  }

  private async readInstalledItem(sourceRevision: string, itemKey: string, signal: AbortSignal, agentId?: string) {
    this.assertSource(sourceRevision);
    const id = agentId ?? this.ctx.invocation?.request.args.agentId;
    const agent = typeof id === 'string' ? this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(id)) : undefined;
    const runtime = this.localRuntime;
    const fs = agent?.ctx.get('fs');
    const cwd = agent?.session.header.cwd;
    const sessionId = agent?.session.id;
    const valid = () => {
      this.assertSource(sourceRevision);
      if (!agent || !runtime || !fs || !cwd || sessionId !== agent.session.id || cwd !== agent.session.header.cwd
        || this.localRuntime !== runtime || this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(agent.session.id)) !== agent
        || serviceIdentity(agent.ctx.get('fs')) !== serviceIdentity(fs)) {
        throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Reopen the installed skill list.', { retryable: false });
      }
    };
    valid();
    const combined = AbortSignal.any([signal, this.lifetime.signal]);
    // Re-read trusted roots rather than retaining an evictable cache or decoding client paths.
    const roots: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof resolveInstalledPath>>[] = [];
    for (const scope of ['user', 'project'] as const) {
      try { roots.push(await resolveInstalledPath({ scope, cwd: cwd!, fs: fs!, signal: combined })); }
      catch { combined.throwIfAborted(); }
    }
    const result = await runtime!.listInstalled(this.getContext().registryUrl, roots);
    combined.throwIfAborted();
    valid();
    const item = result.items.find(item => this.installedItemKey(sessionId!, cwd!, sourceRevision, item) === itemKey);
    if (!item) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Installed record changed or unavailable.', { retryable: false });
    const target = await resolveInstalledPath({ scope: item.scope, cwd: cwd!, fs: fs!, signal: combined });
    if (join(target.root, item.slug) !== item.targetPath) {
      throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Installed target changed.', { retryable: false });
    }
    combined.throwIfAborted();
    valid();
    return { item, valid, agent, runtime, fs };
  }

  private async executePlanForAgent(agentId: string, request: HostExecutePlanRequest, signal: AbortSignal, initiatedFrom: 'plaza' | 'conversation'): Promise<NativeOperation | null> {
    const agent = this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(agentId));
    const runtime = this.localRuntime;
    const hostInstanceId = runtime?.getStatus().hostInstanceId;
    if (!agent || !runtime || !hostInstanceId) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Mutation context unavailable.', { retryable: false });
    try {
      const previous = await runtime.findPlanOperation({ hostInstanceId, ownerId: agent.session.id, requestKey: request.requestKey,
        mode: 'retry', parameters: { planId: request.planId } });
      if (previous) return previous;
      if (this.removalPlans.has(request.planId)) {
        return await runtime.submitRemoval({ hostInstanceId, ownerId: agent.session.id, requestKey: request.requestKey,
          mode: 'new', parameters: { planId: request.planId } }, async () => {
          const combined = AbortSignal.any([signal, this.lifetime.signal]);
          combined.throwIfAborted();
          const context = this.selectionScope(agent);
          const baseline = this.removalPlans.read(request.planId, context);
          const source = this.getContext();
          const filesystem = agent.ctx.get('fs');
          if (!filesystem) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Filesystem unavailable.', { retryable: false });
          const policy = agent.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent.session });
          const target = await resolveInstallationPath({ scope: baseline.target.scope, cwd: context.cwd, fs: filesystem, policy, signal: combined });
          if (target.root !== baseline.target.root) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Removal root changed.', { retryable: false });
          const valid = () => {
            if (agent.session.header.cwd !== context.cwd || serviceIdentity(agent.ctx.get('fs')) !== serviceIdentity(filesystem)
              || this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(agent.session.id)) !== agent || this.localRuntime !== runtime) {
              throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Removal session changed.', { retryable: false });
            }
          };
          valid(); combined.throwIfAborted(); this.assertSource(context.sourceRevision);
          this.removalPlans.claim(request.planId, context, request.requestKey);
          const item = baseline.inventoryItem;
          const operationSignal = new AbortController().signal;
          return {
            acceptance: { kind: baseline.kind, namespace: item.namespace, slug: item.slug, version: item.targets.find(target => target.installDir === baseline.target.path)!.version,
              targetLabel: target.scope === 'user' ? '当前用户' : '当前项目', targetPaths: [baseline.target.path],
              context: { sourceIdentity: source.registryUrl, sourceLabel: source.registryUrl, sourceRevision: context.sourceRevision,
                hostLabel: 'DSH Host', initiatedFrom } },
            execution: { baseline, authorize: async (paths: readonly string[], _phase: string, operationId: string) => {
              valid();
              const currentPolicy = agent.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent.session });
              const current = await resolveInstallationPath({ scope: target.scope, cwd: context.cwd, fs: filesystem,
                policy: currentPolicy, signal: operationSignal });
              valid();
              if (current.root !== target.root || current.dshHome !== target.dshHome) throw new Error('Removal root changed');
              await assertRemovalMutation(target.root, item.slug, operationId, paths, currentPolicy);
            } },
          };
        }) ?? null;
      }
      return await runtime.submitUpgrade({ hostInstanceId, ownerId: agent.session.id, requestKey: request.requestKey,
        mode: 'new', parameters: { planId: request.planId } }, async () => {
        const combined = AbortSignal.any([signal, this.lifetime.signal]);
        combined.throwIfAborted();
        const context = this.selectionScope(agent);
        const snapshot = this.upgradePlans.read(request.planId, context);
        const source = this.getContext();
        const filesystem = agent.ctx.get('fs');
        if (!filesystem) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Filesystem unavailable.', { retryable: false });
        const policy = agent.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent.session });
        const targets: ResolvedInstallationTarget[] = [];
        for (const target of snapshot.baseline.targets) {
          const current = await resolveInstallationPath({ scope: target.scope, cwd: context.cwd, fs: filesystem, policy, signal: combined });
          if (current.root !== target.root) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Upgrade root changed.', { retryable: false });
          targets.push(current);
        }
        combined.throwIfAborted();
        this.assertSource(context.sourceRevision);
        if (agent.session.header.cwd !== context.cwd || serviceIdentity(agent.ctx.get('fs')) !== serviceIdentity(filesystem)
          || this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(agent.session.id)) !== agent || this.localRuntime !== runtime) {
          throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Upgrade session changed.', { retryable: false });
        }
        this.upgradePlans.claim(request.planId, context, request.requestKey);
        const candidate = snapshot.candidate;
        const operationSignal = new AbortController().signal;
        return {
          acceptance: { namespace: candidate.namespace, slug: candidate.slug, version: candidate.version,
            targetLabel: targets.map(target => target.scope === 'user' ? '当前用户' : '当前项目').join('、'),
            targetPaths: snapshot.baseline.targets.map(target => target.path),
            context: { sourceIdentity: source.registryUrl, sourceLabel: source.registryUrl, sourceRevision: context.sourceRevision,
              hostLabel: 'DSH Host', initiatedFrom } },
          execution: { registry: source.registryUrl, namespace: candidate.namespace, slug: candidate.slug,
            version: candidate.version, versionId: candidate.versionId, fingerprint: candidate.fingerprint, baseline: snapshot.baseline,
            authorize: async (paths: readonly string[]) => {
              const fs = agent.ctx.get('fs');
              if (!fs || serviceIdentity(fs) !== serviceIdentity(filesystem) || agent.session.header.cwd !== context.cwd
                || this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(agent.session.id)) !== agent) throw new Error('Upgrade session changed');
              const currentPolicy = agent.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent.session });
              const roots = [];
              for (const target of targets) {
                const current = await resolveInstallationPath({ scope: target.scope, cwd: context.cwd, fs, policy: currentPolicy, signal: operationSignal });
                if (current.root !== target.root || current.dshHome !== target.dshHome) throw new Error('Upgrade root changed');
                roots.push(current.root);
              }
              for (const path of paths) {
                // A mutation batch can contain paths from both approved roots.
                let allowed = false;
                for (const root of roots) {
                  try { await assertInstallationMutation(root, [path], currentPolicy); allowed = true; break; }
                  catch { /* Try the other explicitly confirmed root. */ }
                }
                if (!allowed) throw new Error('Upgrade mutation is outside the confirmed roots');
              }
            },
            validateStaged: (directory: string) => validateDshSkill(agent.ctx, directory, operationSignal),
          }
        };
      }) ?? null;
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof RemoteError) throw error;
      if (error && typeof error === 'object' && 'code' in error && error.code === 'REQUEST_KEY_CONFLICT') {
        throw new RemoteError('skillhub/request-conflict', 'Request parameters changed.', { retryable: false });
      }
      throw new RemoteError('skillhub/installation-unavailable', 'Mutation request could not be accepted.', { retryable: true });
    }
  }

  /** Reissue only from this session's trusted search log; never restore old authorization. */
  @RemoteScope('agent')
  async reopenConversationDetail(callId: string, selectionRef: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<ConversationDetail> {
    const stale = () => new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Search history unavailable. Search again in this conversation.', { retryable: false });
    const id = this.ctx.invocation?.request.args.agentId;
    const agent = typeof id === 'string' ? this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(id)) : undefined;
    const query = this.ctx.get('sessionQuery');
    if (!agent || !query || !callId || callId.length > 1024 || typeof selectionRef !== 'string') throw stale();
    const scope = this.selectionScope(agent);
    const source = this.registry!.source;
    const check = () => {
      signal.throwIfAborted();
      this.lifetime.signal.throwIfAborted();
      const current = this.selectionScope(agent);
      if (this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(scope.sessionId)) !== agent
        || serviceIdentity(this.ctx.get('sessionQuery')) !== serviceIdentity(query)
        || current.sessionId !== scope.sessionId || current.cwd !== scope.cwd
        || current.sourceRevision !== scope.sourceRevision) throw stale();
    };
    check();
    let history;
    try { history = await query.readSession(SessionId(scope.sessionId)); }
    catch { throw stale(); }
    check();
    const candidate = historicalSearchCandidate(history, scope, source, callId, selectionRef);
    if (!candidate) throw stale();
    const detail = await this.getSkillDetail(scope.sourceRevision, candidate.namespace, candidate.slug, candidate.version, signal);
    check();
    const snapshot = this.details.get(detail.detailToken);
    if (!snapshot) throw stale();
    const fresh = this.selections.add({ ...scope, callId }, candidate);
    const fixed = this.selections.stage(fresh, scope, detail.detailToken, snapshot);
    return { ...detail, selectionRef: fixed };
  }
